findings.reason: The background build's «text-migration» checks are wider than what the write path can actually repair, so a project can stay in «needs activation» forever: (1) release backfill catches failures per row (no free slug after 50 attempts / write fails) → slug IS NULL stays, legacyReleasesPending stays true; (2) backfillEntityTimestamps is try/catch + console.warn → entityTimestampsPending stays true; (3) same for plan rows if backfillPlansToFilesystem cannot drop the legacy table. Every later background build ends in «needs activation» again. Fix before U4a wires its production caller: either the write path treats a pending migration it could not complete as a build error, or the background check is limited to what that migration can actually clear.
